label: fibroblast
notes: Starting fibroblast state; principal trajectory origin.

label: fibroblast_like_stalled
notes: Stalled/off-target fibroblast-like branch; does not progress to iPSC.

label: keratinocyte_like
notes: Off-target keratinocyte-like branch diverging from fibroblast.

label: hOSK
notes: Early hOSK-transduced state; entry point of the main reprogramming arm.

label: partial_intermediate
notes: Partial intermediate on the hOSK->partially_reprogrammed arm.

label: partially_reprogrammed
notes: Partially reprogrammed state; stalled on the hOSK arm.

label: xOSK
notes: Early xOSK-transduced state; entry point of the productive reprogramming arm.

label: primary_intermediate
notes: Primary intermediate on the xOSK->pre_iPSC->iPSC arm.

label: pre_iPSC
notes: Pre-iPSC state; immediate precursor to the iPSC endpoint.

label: iPSC
notes: iPSC endpoint; fully reprogrammed pluripotent state.
